reconciliation.finding: Exact DOI set comparison (strip the dashboard 'doi:' prefix, lowercase; retain namespace/path) finds all 34 official dashboard issue DOIs in the 34 local catalog records for year 2025, with no extras or omissions.

The core has 30 papers in three official 2026 issues (10 each); the local catalog has 34 year=2026 records. Exact DOI matching finds all 30 core issue keys among local records; 4 local records are not in those issue sets. Eight local entries have issueLabel '2026' without volume/issue: four correspond to official issue DOIs despite missing local issue assignment; four do not. The latter are 10.15625/0868-3166/24350 (article URL https://vjs.ac.vn/cip/article/view/24350 returned 404), 24173 (https://vjs.ac.vn/cip/article/view/24173, OJS page says Forthcoming/Vol. 36 No. 4), 24168 (https://vjs.ac.vn/cip/article/view/24168, Forthcoming), and 23488 (https://vjs.ac.vn/cip/article/view/23488, Forthcoming). These 4 are distinct from the official 30 issue papers; the other four unnumbered-label catalog records are in the issue DOI set.

reconciliation.finding: All six official issue pages were inspected; dashboard core has 89 unique issue DOI keys and issue counts 15,15,16,14,15,14. The local catalog's year=2025 count (88) misattributes by issue year: all official issue keys are found across the local catalog, but 17 are stored under local years 2023/2024. The 16 local 2025 records absent from the 2025 issue DOI set are unassigned (volume=null, issue=''); e.g. 22876 is publicly labelled Forthcoming despite conflicting publication dates. This is a year/scope reconciliation issue, not a 17-item DOI absence. Use official issue-year set for published 2025 outputs; do not count unassigned Online First as issued.

reconciliation.paperKeyNormalization: Compared DOI after removing dashboard 'doi:' prefix and lowercasing; DOI namespace/path remain exact. 11 dashboard issue DOIs are found in local catalog under earlier years 2024/2025; 12 are absent from the local catalog.
reconciliation.finding: All five official issue pages were inspected; dashboard core has 76 unique issue DOI keys and count breakdown 14,14,16,17,15. 11 DOIs assigned to 2026 issue pages are catalogued under 2024/2025 in the local catalog; 12 issue-5 DOIs are absent from the local catalog (Vol. 64 No. 5 was published 2026-10-20: https://vjs.ac.vn/jst/issue/view/vol64n5). The 25 local 2026 records not in the 2026 issue DOI set are all unassigned Online First records (volume=null, issue=''). The apparent total-count/set mismatch is chiefly issue-year attribution plus unassigned Online First and a stale catalog boundary, not DOI case or namespace normalization. Preserve official published issue-year counts and local unassigned records as separate scopes.

limitations: Original source export filename has no date and .last_synced_csv records no date; actual export/retrieval date unknown; processedAt is not source date.
Catalog has no issue collection. Its year field is not published issue year: confirmed issue DOIs occur under earlier year labels, while entries with no volume/issue are unassigned Online First.

2026 issue 5 was published 2026-10-20 after the source data's latest known processing date 2026-10-19, but the catalog retrieval date is not recorded; this is consistent with, but does not prove, why its 12 DOIs are absent.

Local 4-year values are self-calculated ratios from local citation/paper data, not official CiteScore or Tracker values. Source citeScoreSeries marks year 2026 isTracker=true, but this field alone is not evidence of official Scopus Tracker status.

2025 and 2026 are the dashboard reconciliation focus; full raw catalog article.year count histories are included per journal under catalogPublicationHistory. These raw catalog counts do not automatically equal dashboard eligible research-paper counts or published issue-year counts.
